evidence.reason: At the current tip, the per-candidate dependency reinstall is an awaited call with no local try/catch. Unlike the nearby reserve and comparison failures, which return a `fault` result, an `AbortSignal.timeout(reinstallMs)` rejection from `installDeps` escapes the candidate callback and is handled only by the outer probe-phase catch, discarding the accumulated `scan.probes` history. This is an implementation error in existing fault-handling behavior, not a new requirement.
